title: With a budget a cheap kit of a module comes before a dearer board that has it all

cheap_tft.name: cheap_tft
cheap_tft.title: A cheap panel on QSPI
cheap_tft.description: A round 360x360 display module on QSPI, marked TFT 1.53 1.0. Not a board of its own: a project wires it to one.

lcd.notes: The glass is marked T150XV-C16-04. The size in mm is that of the ST77916 example of esp32-component-dgx-lvgl, not measured.
